free_up_space_confirmation.en:
This removes files earlier runs left behind and saved game apps this game version no longer needs. It keeps the saved game app used for recovery, the prepared files for this game version, and the record that lets you switch languages without clearing game data.

An interrupted run that left no game file half-changed is closed. Keep the game closed while this runs.
free_up_space_confirmation.id:
Ini menghapus file sisa proses sebelumnya dan aplikasi game tersimpan yang tidak lagi diperlukan versi game ini. Aplikasi game tersimpan untuk pemulihan, file siap pakai untuk versi game ini, dan catatan untuk mengganti bahasa tanpa menghapus data game tetap disimpan.

Proses terhenti yang tidak meninggalkan file game setengah berubah akan ditutup. Biarkan game tertutup selama proses ini.

remove_saved_apks.en: Also remove the saved game apps (about {saved}). The next patch copies the game app again and needs about {prepare} free for that.
remove_saved_apks.id: Hapus juga aplikasi game tersimpan (sekitar {saved}). Patch berikutnya menyalin aplikasi game lagi dan memerlukan sekitar {prepare} ruang kosong untuk itu.

finish_work_before_freeing_space.en: Finish the current work before freeing space.
finish_work_before_freeing_space.id: Selesaikan pekerjaan saat ini sebelum mengosongkan ruang.

freed_kept.en: Space freed. The record for switching languages and the saved game app were kept.
freed_kept.id: Ruang dikosongkan. Catatan untuk mengganti bahasa dan aplikasi game tersimpan tetap disimpan.

freed_removed_apks.en: Space freed. The record for switching languages was kept. The saved game apps were removed; the next patch prepares them again.
freed_removed_apks.id: Ruang dikosongkan. Catatan untuk mengganti bahasa tetap disimpan. Aplikasi game tersimpan dihapus; patch berikutnya menyiapkannya lagi.

kept_saved_apps_installed_not_one.en: Kept the saved game apps: the installed game app is not one of them
kept_saved_apps_installed_not_one.id: Aplikasi game tersimpan tetap disimpan: aplikasi game yang terpasang bukan salah satunya

closed_run_nothing_half_changed.en: Closed an interrupted run that left no game file half-changed
closed_run_nothing_half_changed.id: Proses terhenti yang tidak meninggalkan file game setengah berubah telah ditutup

closed_run_game_changed_files.en: The game changed its files after the translation was written; closing the run without checking them again
closed_run_game_changed_files.id: Game mengubah file-nya setelah terjemahan ditulis; proses ditutup tanpa memeriksanya lagi

recovered_unconfirmed.en: Recovery finished. Normal game app verified. The translation was written and checked, but the game changed its files afterwards, so they were not checked again. If some text is Chinese, tap Start to patch again.
recovered_unconfirmed.id: Pemulihan selesai. Aplikasi game normal terverifikasi. Terjemahan sudah ditulis dan diperiksa, tetapi game mengubah file-nya setelah itu, sehingga file tidak diperiksa lagi. Jika ada teks berbahasa Tionghoa, ketuk Mulai untuk patch lagi.

after_reinstalling_check_the_game_app.en: After reinstalling, check the game app below. Unfinished file changes still need recovery.
after_reinstalling_check_the_game_app.id: Setelah memasang ulang, periksa aplikasi game di bawah. Perubahan file yang belum selesai tetap perlu dipulihkan.

language_note_no_clear.en: Switching languages? No need to clear: the patcher kept the original game files it changed.
language_note_no_clear.id: Mengganti bahasa? Tidak perlu menghapus data: patcher menyimpan file game asli yang diubahnya.

language_note_clear_first.en: Switching languages on a phone another patcher or an older version translated? Clear the game's data and download it again first.
language_note_clear_first.id: Mengganti bahasa di ponsel yang diterjemahkan patcher lain atau versi lama? Hapus data game dan unduh ulang terlebih dahulu.

remove_confirmation.en:
This writes the game's original files back, so the game reads in Chinese again. No game data is deleted and no download is needed.

The game keeps the patcher-signed app: keep using Scan to login. For the official app, reinstall the game from the store.
remove_confirmation.id:
Ini menulis kembali file game asli, sehingga game kembali berbahasa Tionghoa. Data game tidak dihapus dan tidak perlu mengunduh ulang.

Game tetap memakai aplikasi bertanda tangan patcher: tetap gunakan Scan to login. Untuk aplikasi resmi, instal ulang game dari toko.

nothing_to_remove_no_record.en: This patcher has no record of a translation on this phone, so there is nothing to remove.
nothing_to_remove_no_record.id: Patcher ini tidak punya catatan terjemahan di ponsel ini, jadi tidak ada yang dihapus.

nothing_to_remove_official.en: The game on this phone is the official build, which this patcher never translated, so there is nothing to remove.
nothing_to_remove_official.id: Game di ponsel ini adalah versi resmi yang belum pernah diterjemahkan patcher ini, jadi tidak ada yang dihapus.

removal_verified.en: Translation removed. Normal game app verified.
removal_verified.id: Terjemahan dihapus. Aplikasi game normal terverifikasi.

removed_login_note.en: Keep using Scan to login. For the official app, reinstall the game from the store.
removed_login_note.id: Tetap gunakan Scan to login. Untuk aplikasi resmi, instal ulang game dari toko.

added_login_note.en: Log in with Scan to login. Direct WeChat or QQ login does not work with this game app.
added_login_note.id: Masuk dengan Scan to login. Login langsung WeChat atau QQ tidak berfungsi dengan aplikasi game ini.

keep_the_game_closed_use_recovery_first.en: Keep the game closed. Use recovery first.
keep_the_game_closed_use_recovery_first.id: Jangan buka game. Pulihkan terlebih dahulu.

access_was_not_allowed_tap_start_to_try.id: Akses tidak diizinkan. Ketuk Mulai untuk mencoba lagi.

more_than_one_unfinished_run_was_found.id: Ada lebih dari satu proses yang belum selesai. Pilih proses yang sesuai di pilihan pemulihan.

work_was_interrupted_tap_start_to_check.id: Proses terhenti. Ketuk Mulai untuk memeriksa dan memulihkan proses yang belum selesai.

tap_start_we_will_check_your_game_and.id: Ketuk Mulai. Game akan diperiksa dan semua file disiapkan. Jangan buka game selama proses.

first_setup_deletes_local_game_data.id: Penyiapan awal menghapus data lokal game

copy_and_verify_installed_apk_about_2_gb.id: Salin dan periksa APK terpasang (sekitar 2 GB)

verify_installed_normal_apk_with.en: Verify installed normal APK with foreground worker
verify_installed_normal_apk_with.id: Periksa APK normal terpasang dengan proses latar depan

checking_the_installed_normal_game_app.id: Memeriksa aplikasi game normal yang terpasang

checking_other_android_profiles_for_the.id: Memeriksa game di profil Android lain

completed_no_counts.en: Patch complete. Normal game app verified; result counts are unavailable.
completed_no_counts.id: Patch selesai. Aplikasi game normal terverifikasi; jumlah hasil tidak tersedia.

first_setup_consent.en:
1. This deletes saved game data, downloads and login on this phone.

2. Download all game updates again.

3. Direct WeChat/QQ login stops working. Use Scan to login.

4. Translation is added later, after you confirm that downloads finished.

First setup has not passed all phone tests.
first_setup_consent.id:
1. Data game, unduhan, dan login tersimpan di ponsel ini akan dihapus.

2. Unduh ulang semua pembaruan game.

3. Login langsung WeChat/QQ tidak akan berfungsi. Gunakan Scan to login.

4. Terjemahan ditambahkan setelah Anda mengonfirmasi unduhan selesai.

Penyiapan awal belum lulus semua pengujian ponsel.

setup_update.en: Open the game, complete all downloads, then close it. We will then prepare the new files automatically. Translation starts after the final update confirmation.
setup_update.id: Buka game, selesaikan semua unduhan, lalu tutup game. File baru akan disiapkan otomatis. Terjemahan dimulai setelah konfirmasi pembaruan terakhir.

patch_confirmation.en:
1. Finish ALL downloads in the game.
2. Close the game.

3. We change game files and briefly replace the game app.

4. Keep the game CLOSED until work or recovery finishes.

Language: {language}

Adding the translation has not passed all phone tests.
patch_confirmation.id:
1. Selesaikan SEMUA unduhan dalam game.
2. Tutup game.

3. Kami akan mengubah file game dan mengganti aplikasi game untuk sementara.

4. JANGAN BUKA game sampai proses atau pemulihan selesai.

Bahasa: {language}

Penerapan terjemahan belum lulus semua pengujian ponsel.

restore_apk_only.en: Restore version {version} with data retained. This restores the APK only. Unresolved package writes still require rollback before launching the game. Opening the installer does not verify a completed restoration.
restore_apk_only.id: Pulihkan versi {version} tanpa menghapus data. Ini hanya memulihkan APK. Penulisan paket yang belum selesai masih harus dipulihkan sebelum game dibuka. Membuka pemasang tidak berarti pemulihan sudah terverifikasi.

before_you_start_tips.en:
1.  Enable USB debugging on the phone, connect the USB cable and tap 'Allow'.
2.  Open the game once until the data download finishes (login screen), then close it.
3.  If Google Play Protect asks, tap 'More details' → 'Install anyway'.
before_you_start_tips.id:
1.  Aktifkan USB debugging di ponsel, sambungkan kabel USB, lalu ketuk 'Izinkan'.
2.  Buka game sekali sampai unduhan data selesai (layar login), lalu tutup game.
3.  Jika Google Play Protect bertanya, ketuk 'Detail lainnya' → 'Tetap instal'.

result_open_game.en:
Open the game on your phone.

Login: use 'Scan to login' (the direct WeChat/QQ buttons do not work). With one phone: screenshot the QR code, open WeChat in split screen and scan it from the gallery.
result_open_game.id:
Buka game di ponsel.

Login: gunakan 'Scan to login' (tombol WeChat/QQ langsung tidak berfungsi). Dengan satu ponsel: tangkap layar kode QR, buka WeChat dalam layar terpisah, lalu pindai dari galeri.

unexpected_error.en: An unexpected error occurred. See the log in this window.
unexpected_error.id: Terjadi galat tak terduga. Lihat log di jendela ini.

close_while_busy.en:
Closing now can leave the game unable to start until the patcher is run again.

Close anyway?
close_while_busy.id:
Menutup sekarang dapat membuat game tidak bisa dibuka sampai patcher dijalankan lagi.

Tetap tutup?

reinstall_required.en:
The game on this phone uses the official Tencent signature, so it must be reinstalled with the patcher signature.

This DELETES the game data on the phone and the game will download its data again (~1.7 GB). Direct WeChat/QQ login will no longer work; use 'Scan to login' instead.

Continue?
reinstall_required.id:
Game di ponsel ini memakai tanda tangan resmi Tencent, jadi harus dipasang ulang dengan tanda tangan patcher.

Ini MENGHAPUS data game di ponsel dan game akan mengunduh datanya lagi (~1,7 GB). Login langsung WeChat/QQ tidak akan berfungsi lagi; gunakan 'Scan to login'.

Lanjutkan?

download_game_data.en:
Open the game on the phone, accept the policies and wait until the data download finishes and the login screen appears.

Then CLOSE the game and click OK here.
download_game_data.id:
Buka game di ponsel, setujui kebijakannya, dan tunggu sampai unduhan data selesai dan layar login muncul.

Lalu TUTUP game dan klik OK di sini.

retry_install.en: Installing the normal game APK failed. Try again?
retry_install.id: Pemasangan APK game normal gagal. Coba lagi?
